title: PersonaMix Solo #24 (솔로 · 산호·조개 · 산호·조개 복숭아 · 앵글 극단 3/4 앵글 · 체형 BBW bombshell · 인종 Indian · 메이크업 잉크 블랙립(포인트) · 배경 중국 정원(비 갠 뒤) · 힐 숫자 없음 · 몸 주얼리)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm golden-brown complexion, early 20s goddess, BBW bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most massive full-figure BBW body ever at absolute maximum in every dimension, hips so wide beyond proportion dominating the entire frame, bust so enormous overwhelming gravity, waist deeply snatched despite impossible volume, blunt bob golden blonde hair — full body carved peach coral and iridescent mother-of-pearl fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is solid coral and shell curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted coral sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING soft peach-orange branching coral relief across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID iridescent pearl-white nacre sections shimmering pink and mint between the coral, with mother-of-pearl flowers inlaid into the sections, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: leaning against a pillar with one arm resting on it, one knee bent — most extreme BBW bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals made of the same coral and mother-of-pearl, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, made of the same coral and mother-of-pearl with a high polish.
Jewelry: heavy gold rings on every finger, a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee, and a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT coral — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Indian woman with large almond eyes, strong brows and a defined nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: a blurred ink-black gradient across the lids like soft smoke, a fine black liner, natural full lashes, a glass-skin highlight on the cheekbones, ink-black glossy lips with a softly blurred gradient edge.

Background: a classical Chinese garden with a stone path, a zigzag bridge with a waist-high rail, a moon gate of standard height and a pavilion, just after the rain, with wet surfaces shining softly, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length EXTREME three-quarter view from the far front-left, her whole body turned a full sixty degrees away from the camera with her shoulders and hips twisted, the camera at waist height and pushed close for strong foreshortening, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
